daten.programm.erdbeben.leitbild: Never again collapsed houses: first know what is at risk, then inspect, rehouse and build up civil protection.
daten.programm.preise.leitbild: Make the lira valuable again: budget discipline, collecting taxes instead of raising them, and a central bank left to work in peace.
daten.programm.regionen.leitbild: A country without a hinterland: roads, rail and internet down to the village, so no one has to move away for work.
daten.programm.gesundheit.leitbild: A doctor in town, a hospital bed, short waiting times: health must not depend on the province you live in.
daten.programm.recht.leitbild: Those who trust the state pay taxes and vote: open tenders, independent judges and media allowed to ask questions.
daten.programm.wasserenergie.titel: Water and energy for the future
daten.programm.wasserenergie.leitbild: Clean water from the tap, power that does not fail, and an energy supply that does not hang on foreign prices.
daten.programm.sicherheit.leitbild: Living safely without security becoming a pretext: modern agencies, secure borders and a peace process that lasts.
daten.programm.welt.leitbild: A partner rather than a bystander: talking to Brussels and Washington, trade without waiting times and a way of handling refugees that works.
daten.programm.erdbeben.erdbeben1.text: A register shows which houses cannot withstand an earthquake.
daten.programm.erdbeben.erdbeben2.text: Experts independent of the developer check structure and materials.
daten.programm.erdbeben.erdbeben2.ergebn: Building quality +4; housing costs 15 % less capital
daten.programm.erdbeben.erdbeben3.text: Anyone living in an unsafe house is offered a safe one, not just a demolition order.
daten.programm.erdbeben.erdbeben4.text: An agency coordinates rescue, emergency shelter and reconstruction before the next earthquake strikes.
daten.programm.erdbeben.erdbeben4.ergebn: Earthquakes hit the country with only 70 % of their force
daten.programm.erdbeben.erdbeben5.text: In the earthquake zones there is hardly a house left that people do not trust.
daten.programm.preise.preise1.text: The president publicly commits to a sound budget.
daten.programm.preise.preise2.titel: Collect taxes instead of raising them
daten.programm.preise.preise2.text: More inspectors, digital tax administration: whoever has to pay, pays.
daten.programm.preise.preise2.ergebnis: Tax revenue +3, tax honesty +2; budget measures cost 15 % less capital
daten.programm.preise.preise3.text: Half a year without public attacks on the central bank: the markets notice.
daten.programm.preise.preise4.text: Inflation falls below 22 per cent: for the first time in a long while prices fall not only in the report.
daten.programm.preise.preise5.text: Inflation is below 15 per cent and stays there.
daten.programm.regionen.regionen1.text: The road network is expanded where it is lacking.
daten.programm.regionen.regionen2.text: Freight onto the rails, ports connected to the network.
daten.programm.regionen.regionen3.text: Those who live in the countryside can work there too.
daten.programm.regionen.regionen4.text: Support concentrated in provinces that would otherwise be left behind.
daten.programm.regionen.regionen4.ergebn: Regional growth +4; infrastructure costs 15 % less capital
daten.programm.regionen.regionen5.text: Hardly any province still loses its young people to the cities.
daten.programm.gesundheit.gesundheit1.te: Family doctors as the first point of contact take pressure off the hospitals.
daten.programm.gesundheit.gesundheit2.te: Better pay and conditions keep doctors in the country.
daten.programm.gesundheit.gesundheit2.er: Doctors in the country +3, brain drain −1
daten.programm.gesundheit.gesundheit3.te: New hospitals where the nearest clinic is too far away.
daten.programm.gesundheit.gesundheit3.er: Healthcare +4; health measures cost 15 % less capital
daten.programm.gesundheit.gesundheit4.te: No province is short of doctors any more.
daten.programm.recht.recht1.text: Every large tender is open to inspection, every fortune declared.
daten.programm.recht.recht2.text: Judges are appointed by a council of judges, not by the government.
daten.programm.recht.recht2.ergebnis: Legal certainty +4, trust in the judiciary +3
daten.programm.recht.recht3.text: The regulator only intervenes in case of crimes.
daten.programm.recht.recht4.text: Corruption is the exception and the judiciary is considered independent.
daten.programm.wasserenergie.wasser1.tex: Pipes and treatment plants where water is scarce.
daten.programm.wasserenergie.wasser2.tex: Drip irrigation saves water, reservoirs buffer the dry season.
daten.programm.wasserenergie.wasser2.erg: Drought −3, harvest +2; agriculture costs 15 % less capital
daten.programm.wasserenergie.wasser3.tex: Tenders for renewable power cut imports.
daten.programm.wasserenergie.wasser4.tex: Lines and batteries keep power in the grid when the wind drops.
daten.programm.wasserenergie.wasser4.erg: Electricity supply +4; energy costs 15 % less capital
daten.programm.wasserenergie.wasser5.tex: No acute water shortage, no acute power cuts.
daten.programm.sicherheit.sicherheit2.te: Technology and staff at the crossings, not just walls.
daten.programm.sicherheit.sicherheit4.te: Terror and crime are low, and no one fears the state.
daten.programm.welt.welt1.text: Reforms in return for visa freedom and a modernised customs union.
daten.programm.welt.welt3.text: Language courses, work permits, school places.
daten.programm.welt.welt4.text: Brussels and Washington call before they decide.
